description.value: Zabu Chicken is Vancouver's pioneering Korean fried chicken restaurant, established in 2011 on busy Robson Street and acclaimed by Eater, Vancouver Magazine, and SCOUT Vancouver. The menu centres on triple-fried chicken in soy-garlic and hot sauce styles, served whole, as sticks, or as wings. Both indoor and outdoor seating are available, making it a solid post-ride stop for a hearty late-evening meal.
